column2: Statement
I enjoy fixing things at home, like a loose cycle chain or a switch that has stopped working.
I like figuring out why things happen, like why the sky is blue or how a phone works.
I often daydream and make up stories, characters or magical worlds.
I enjoy explaining things to friends or helping a younger cousin study.
I like taking charge, like organising a class trip or a school event.
I like keeping my things, notes and files neat and organised.
I'd rather build or put something together with my hands than read about it.
I enjoy tricky puzzles or maths problems, even when nobody has asked me to solve them.
I enjoy drawing, painting, rangoli or making things look beautiful.
Friends often come to me when they want to talk about a problem.
I'd enjoy selling things, like running a stall at the school fair or a small online shop.
I enjoy making timetables or to-do lists and sticking to them.
I like being outdoors: gardening, farming, trekking or looking after animals.
I'd enjoy doing an experiment for a science fair.
I like performing: singing, dancing, acting or playing an instrument.
I'd enjoy volunteering at an NGO, a hospital or in my neighbourhood.
I enjoy convincing people to see things my way, like in a debate.
I'd enjoy keeping track of money, like a family budget or the class fund.
I enjoy using tools and machines, from a screwdriver to a sewing machine.
I watch documentaries or read about science and technology for fun.
I like making creative things like videos, reels, poems or stories.
I enjoy working in a team more than working alone.
I'd like to start my own business one day.
I like work with clear rules and steps, where I know exactly what to do.
I'd rather be active and on my feet than sit at a desk all day.
When I hear a claim, I try to verify it myself before accepting it.
I prefer doing things my own way rather than following a fixed method.
I feel good when I take care of someone who is unwell or upset.
I stay calm and make quick decisions when there's pressure.
I notice small mistakes that others miss, like a wrong number or a spelling error.
